title: Special Markowitz: Thermodynamic Formalism for the Joint Regularisation of Returns and Covariance
abstract: arXiv:2609.14029v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Special Markowitz (SM) regularises returns and covariance jointly, relative to a reference state (mu_ref, Sigma_ref). Each eigendirection of the whitened relative operator carries a spectral reliability potential Phi_k, derived from its estimation quality. Its Gibbs weight exp(-Phi_k) governs both the fraction of the return signal and the fraction of the covariance deviation that survive regularisation. Reliable modes (low Phi_k) are preserved; unreliable modes (high Phi_k) relax to the reference. The logarithmic potential coordinate is characterised by a multiplicative composition law; the Stein loss is characterised as the unique free-energy density (within a natural class) compatible with the resulting coupling. The SM pressure functional is additive across modes - the defining property of Special Markowitz.

translated_title: 特殊马科维茨：收益与协方差联合正则化的热力学形式体系
translated_abstract: 特殊马科维茨（SM）方法相对于参考状态（mu_ref, Sigma_ref）对收益和协方差进行联合正则化。白化相对算子的每个特征方向都携带一个由其估计质量导出的谱可靠性势 Phi_k。其吉布斯权重 exp(-Phi_k) 同时控制在正则化后得以保留的收益信号比例和协方差偏差比例。可靠的模态（低 Phi_k）被保留；不可靠的模态（高 Phi_k）则弛豫到参考状态。对数势坐标由乘法复合律刻画；Stein 损失被刻画为（在自然类内）与所产生的耦合相容的唯一自由能密度。SM 压强泛函在各模态间具有可加性——这正是特殊马科维茨的定义性属性。
tldr: 该论文提出特殊马科维茨（SM）框架，通过谱可靠性势与吉布斯权重的热力学形式体系，相对于参考状态对收益和协方差进行联合正则化，保留可靠模态并使不可靠模态弛豫至参考状态，并证明Stein损失是与该耦合相容的唯一自由能密度。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Special Markowitz (SM), a thermodynamic formalism that jointly regularises returns and covariance relative to a reference state via spectral reliability potentials and Gibbs weights—preserving reliable modes while relaxing unreliable ones—and characterises the Stein loss as the unique free-energy density compatible with this coupling.
